description: Lists the folders the people of a mailbox made in it, beside the six every mailbox has (inbox, sent, drafts, spam, trash, archive), each with its id, its name, its full path ("Clients/LCS") and its parent. The ids are what list_conversations, search_conversations and file_conversation take, and what update_folder and delete_folder act on.

box.description: The address of the mailbox to look in, for example "simon@sonentreprise.com": call list_sender_addresses to find it. A support queue is not a mailbox and has no folders.

name: list_folders
title: List the folders of a mailbox
